name: minecart-chest-container
comment: WP-4.6. A chest minecart's IInventory (EntityMinecart.java:716-761) in a ContainerChest (ContainerChest.java:7-56), the window EntityMinecart.interact opens (EntityMinecart.java:772-775). The player (id 0) on stone at (0.5, 61, 0.5) with 20 cobblestone in hotbar slot 0 and 5 planks in slot 1; a chest minecart (spawn Minecart type 1, id 1) at (2.5, 61, 0.5), off rails. t=2 interact: true (HarnessPlayer.displayGUIChest is EntityPlayer's empty body). Then slot_click on the container "minecart 1" (new ContainerChest(inventory, cart); slots 0-26 the cart, 27-53 the main inventory, 54-62 the hotbar): t=3 pick up the cobblestone (54), t=4 put it in cart slot 0, t=5 pick up the planks (55), t=6 right-click one plank into cart slot 1, t=7 left-click the other four onto it, t=8 shift-click cart slot 0 (ContainerChest.getStackInSlot: back to the player's inventory, from the end), t=9 left-click cart slot 1 (picks the 5 planks up), t=10 right-click cart slot 26 (one plank), t=11 left-click cart slot 2 (the other four). t=20 a direct hit of 5 with no attacker breaks the cart (minecartCurrentDamage 50 > 40, EntityMinecart.java:73-115): the cart item, the chest and the cargo in slots 2 and 26 drop as EntityItems. inventory and entity_state every tick, rng_state.
